# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.5.6-beta

- Dashboard graphs represent registered work. Open the full matrix for discovered files and historical audit, or select a Deliverable to load its details.
- Candidate increment plans retain stable links when visible numbers change. Merged candidates retain their identity and target increment.
- Dashboard acceptance metrics refer to governed Deliverables. Context shows the CLI version, project contracts, shipped and pinned packs, and instance versions.
### Compatibility

Existing requirement registries and template pins can be read as saved. Candidate planning is optional and uses a separate planning file. Regenerate existing Dashboards to use the new views.

### Approval boundary

A candidate merge records a planning decision. Governed scope, Deliverable acceptance and template publication each require their existing approval steps.

### Known limitations

The landing page indexes registered work. Browse discovered files in Deliverable details or search them in the full matrix. No private Golden fixture was available.

The [bilingual work-product guides](https://github.com/zju-CS-yzy/ipd-agent-workflow-skill/tree/v0.5.6-beta/docs) describe usage. Public synthetic qualification and real-project acceptance are tracked separately.

### 兼容性

现有项目可直接重画，候选计划按需启用。主依赖图展示已登记成果，交付件详情与历史审计按需打开。候选增量保留稳定编号和合入记录，展示序号可以调整。Context 分别显示工具、项目契约、模板包与实例版本。

### 审批边界

候选合入记录规划决定。正式范围、交付件接受和模板发布分别经过既有审批。

### 已知限制

普通文件可在交付件详情浏览或在完整矩阵搜索。本轮无可用的私有 Golden 夹具。
